purpose: Persist production observations, bounded experiments and reusable learnings so improvement decisions are evidence-driven rather than chat-impression-driven.

observations.description: Useful mechanisms and completed work could remain trapped in sibling dialogs, forcing the Founder to repeatedly nudge continuation or reconstruct prior work.
evidence: Founder explicitly identified repeated 'и' as unnecessary workflow plumbing
Project-Wide Continuation and current-router work were created to solve the recurring problem
observations.generalization_hypothesis: Persisted shared state plus delta-harvest/autopilot reduces repeated context reconstruction across all IVDIVO domains.

observations.description: A sibling dialog advanced CURRENT_IVDIVO_SYSTEM_STATE while Self-Improvement work was in progress; stale overwrite would have destroyed newer project frontier data.
evidence: Freshness sweep showed schema 1.4 and a newer D09 final-gate frontier before v2 aggregate-state write
v2 was rebased onto the newer state rather than replacing it
observations.generalization_hypothesis: Every material system write should use freshness read + compare/rebase rather than optimistic overwrite.

observations.description: SI-0007 was initially marked APPLIED_UNVERIFIED before one declared application target, aggregate CURRENT_IVDIVO_SYSTEM_STATE, had actually been migrated.
evidence: Self-audit compared lifecycle status with application map
Status was downgraded to APPLYING before continuing
observations.generalization_hypothesis: The improvement engine must verify declared application targets before allowing lifecycle promotion, including for changes to itself.

observations.description: Exact current GitHub utility cannot yet be smoke-tested from repository checkout because the execution container cannot resolve github.com and the GitHub connector does not mount a runnable checkout.
evidence: git clone failed with DNS resolution error in execution container
GitHub connector readback confirms current utility source exists
observations.generalization_hypothesis: Runtime evidence must remain distinct from source inspection; unavailable runtime is a bounded verification gap, not permission to claim PASS.

observations.description: A project-specific forensic audio issue yielded a reusable shared musical-fact/motif identity mechanism without transferring ROOM 917 story canon.
evidence: Current audio system state records shared musical-fact contract as integrated universal audio consistency gate
observations.generalization_hypothesis: Successful project-specific fixes should be mined for portable abstract mechanisms after stripping project identities and clue content.

experiments.baseline: Write v2 aggregate state from an older remembered/system snapshot.
experiments.treatment: Freshness-read current schema 1.4, preserve newer sibling D09/runtime/audio/multi-AI frontier, and rebase only self-improvement routing/state into schema 1.5.
result_evidence: D09 remains Final Story Gate PASS awaiting Founder lock
experiments.decision: PASS — use freshness/rebase for universal current-state changes.
experiments.next_action: Retain as required universal concurrency/write-through behavior.

experiments.baseline: Allow an improvement candidate to claim APPLIED_UNVERIFIED when some declared application targets are still pending.
experiments.treatment: Audit lifecycle state against application map and downgrade candidate to APPLYING until all targets are actually migrated.
evidence_plan: Compare status to application targets before aggregate write
result_evidence: SI-0007 was changed from APPLIED_UNVERIFIED to APPLYING before aggregate migration
experiments.decision: PASS — promotion-state integrity applies to Self-Improvement itself.
experiments.next_action: Advance to APPLIED_UNVERIFIED only after all declared targets are readback-valid.

experiments.treatment: Execute exact current tools/ivdivo_self_improvement.py against exact current registry from a runnable repository checkout.
evidence_plan: Run next/queue query for book/audio production
Run negative lifecycle test on a temporary registry copy
result_evidence: Execution container git clone attempt failed because github.com could not be resolved
experiments.decision: BLOCKED BY RUNTIME ENVIRONMENT — keep utility runtime PROVISIONAL.
experiments.next_action: Run exact smoke when a repository checkout or executable connector/file mount is available.

learnings.statement: Self-improvement must serve an ordered production objective: books first, locked-book-to-audio second, factory optimization and research afterward.
learnings.confidence_basis: Direct Founder priority plus consistency with Story First law.

learnings.statement: System-wide improvements require freshness-read/rebase before writes because sibling dialogs may advance the same current frontier concurrently.
learnings.confidence_basis: Observed real concurrent-state advance and successful non-destructive rebase.

learnings.statement: A candidate's lifecycle status must be derived from completed evidence/application state, never from intention or document existence.
learnings.confidence_basis: Self-referential Red Team caught and corrected a real premature state claim.

learnings.statement: Runtime verification and source inspection are separate evidence classes; unavailable runtime must remain explicit rather than being inferred from code review.
learnings.confidence_basis: Observed environment limitation during attempted exact checkout smoke.
